title: Canonical rational triangulation adapters
statement: Let l be prime. Coefficient fields are finite extensions of Q_l with specified Q_l-algebra embeddings. Use the actual completed coefficient sheaves and raw rationalizations of [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension] and [def-weil-pbc-rational-category]. Schemes supporting a constructible rational category are assumed noetherian, finite-dimensional, with l invertible; ambient operation comparisons are for arbitrary scheme morphisms g : X → Y in the actual ambient derived categories. The completed integral constructible category and its raw rationalization carry the zero objects, integer shifts, additive shifts, triangulation, isomorphism closure and field-linear structures specified by the existing uniform-complete and rational-transport witnesses. All adapters select those identical witnesses.

source.place: Order 1307; existing scalar-extension component, relocated without changing signatures or proofs.

proof.text: Project the zero object, shift functors, additive shifts, localization shift comparison, pretriangulation and TR4 from the single existing rational-triangulation witness. These are exactly the same successive projections, so the propositional class arguments agree by proof irrelevance.
Project isomorphism closure from the uniform complete integral triangulation, and retain the existing field-linear action on the same raw rationalization.
